detail.longDescription: gt 2.0.0 is out 🚀 Gitea CLI is now ~4x cheaper for AI coding agents: 📉 Failed Actions run logs: ~46.8k → ~11.6k tokens 📉 Piped commit lists: ~2.1k → ~1.2k tokens Plus gh-style flags, reliable --json, and scoped CI token support. https:// blog.gitea.com/release-of-gite a-cli-2.0.0/ # Gitea # CLI # AIAgents
